2. सञ्ज् (or सज्) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxiii, 18) स॑जति (rarely Ā. ˚ते; pf. ससञ्ज, Br. &c. [in some rare and doubtful cases in MBh. & Ragh. ससज्ज]; 3. pl. सेजुः, ŚBr.; aor. असाङ्क्षीत्, साङ्क्षीत्, Up. &c.; असञ्जि, Br.; अ॑सक्थास्, ˚त, RV.; Br.; Prec. सज्यात् Gr.; fut. सङ्क्ता, सङ्क्ष्यति, ib.; inf. सक्तुम्, MBh.; सङ्क्तोस्, Br.; ind.p. -सज्य, -स॑ङ्गम्, ib. &c.),
to cling or stick or adhere to, be attached to or engaged in or occupied with (loc.), Br.; Ragh.; Naiṣ. :
Pass. सज्य॑ते (generally सज्जते, ep. also ˚ति), to be attached or fastened, adhere, cling, stick (with न, ‘to fly through without sticking’, as an arrow), ŚBr. &c. &c.;
to linger, hesitate, MBh.; R.;
to be devoted to or intent on or occupied with (loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. सञ्जयति (aor. अससञ्जत्; for सज्जयति See √ सज्ज्),
to cause to stick or cling to, unite or connect with (loc.), Bhag.; Śaṃk. :
